result.one_liner: Comprehensive observability and monitoring platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for metrics, logs, traces, and infrastructure monitoring.

evidence.quote: API Key Method: Requests that write data require an API key. OAuth2 Method: Datadog access tokens are short-lived tokens with a time-to-live (TTL) of 1 hour that grant access to Datadog APIs.
The Free tier covers up to 5 hosts with core dashboards, 1,000-plus integrations, and one day of metric retention. Free tier exists primarily for proof-of-concept deployments.
Datadog API is an HTTP REST API. Datadog GraphQL API offers flexible querying options for metrics, events, and logs.
Both Pro and Enterprise provide access to all monitoring products. Differences in SSO/SAML, custom RBAC, extended retention, and priority support.

result.notes: Datadog offers self-serve free tier for evaluation (proof-of-concept), but comprehensive API access for production use requires Pro or Enterprise paid plans. Free tier is severely limited (5 hosts, 1-day retention). API breadth estimated as large (>300 endpoints) based on platform comprehensiveness covering dashboards, alerts, monitors, metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, and infrastructure. OAuth2 and API keys are primary auth methods. No official MCP server found.
